get_daily_checklist.description: Today's checklist: Jay's own habits (done or not) and measured targets. When the measured protein includes AI estimates from meal photos, ai_estimated says how much; treat that protein as approximate.
get_daily_checklist.name: get_daily_checklist

get_exercise_progress.description: Change in best estimated 1-rep max per exercise (exercises with 2+ sessions). Input: weeks (4, 12 or 26).
get_exercise_progress.name: get_exercise_progress

get_food_products.description: Foods and products Jay usually has, with per-serving nutrition (null = unknown).
get_food_products.name: get_food_products

get_health_plan.description: The current health plan: dates and daily targets (calories, macros, steps, strength and cardio sessions per week), plus reference_targets: outside recommendations (for example a dietitian) labelled with their source, all not_active. Never present a reference target as the active plan.
get_health_plan.name: get_health_plan

get_health_today.description: Today's calories (eaten, target, budget left), burned so far, energy balance so far, macros, steps, exercise minutes, water logged vs target and latest weight. When the food totals include AI estimates from meal photos, calories_kcal.ai_estimated says how many items and how much; treat those totals as approximate.
get_health_today.name: get_health_today

get_hevy_routines.description: Jay's Hevy routines and their exercises.
get_hevy_routines.name: get_hevy_routines

get_recent_workouts.description: The most recent Hevy workouts with each exercise's best set. Input: count (1-5).
get_recent_workouts.name: get_recent_workouts

get_training_summary.description: This week's workouts against the plan target, volume, training time, workouts per week for 8 weeks, and muscle-group shares over 30 days.
get_training_summary.name: get_training_summary

get_weight_trend.description: Weight readings from the last 90 days (date, kg), latest reading, the 7-day average (null when fewer than 4 days have readings) and change since the plan started.
get_weight_trend.name: get_weight_trend

suggest_gyst_page.description: Attach one button that opens a GYST Health page relevant to your answer. Use at most once, only when the page helps.
suggest_gyst_page.name: suggest_gyst_page
